subject.title: feat(zalouser): recover accepted messages after local crashes

question: Should the durable ingress queue gain a narrowly scoped storage path for documented local/path Zalo Personal installs, or should this feature remain unavailable to those installs despite the current documentation?
rationale: The existing state restriction is an intentional trust boundary, so choosing a safe persistence seam cannot be resolved solely by changing this call site.

options.title: Add a safe plugin-scoped persistence seam
options.body: Preserve documented local/path installation by exposing only the durable queue capability needed by this plugin, with an explicit trust and data-ownership contract.

options.title: Limit durability to trusted installs
options.body: Keep the current state restriction and revise installation and feature documentation to make crash recovery unavailable for local/path installs.

recommendation.title: Add a safe plugin-scoped persistence seam
recommendation.body: Preserve documented local/path installation by exposing only the durable queue capability needed by this plugin, with an explicit trust and data-ownership contract.
